citation: USGA and The R&A, "Second report on the study of spin generation" (12 January 2007), appendix D, "Results of experiment on golf ball impact with green surface", figures 1 and 3 to 5.

conditions.lie: driver teed 35 mm, other clubs on fairway 5 mm

targets.note: Values on the report's fits. Outbound speed and angle depend on the inbound angle, outbound spin on the inbound spin. The inbound speed and spin are the middle test settings, 75 ft/s and 6,000 rpm, unless the name gives the spin. The impacts covered 35.8 to 58.9 deg. The spreads are the scatter of the plotted impacts about each fit. Angles below horizontal in, above it out. Backspin positive.
